title: Editing a term opens it filled and keeps its own name valid
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 10 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-19 Net 10.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Click "Save Changes" without changing anything.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Edit Credit Term" opens with the Name {Term-A}, "Due Net X days" chosen and 10 in the Days box; the buttons are "Cancel" and "Save Changes".
  • Step 3: no "already exists" message shows; the window closes and the toast "{Term-A} saved" shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S2-R4: “"Edit" opens the "Edit Credit Term" window (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) filled with the term's name, kind and days.”
  • S3-R1: “"New Credit Term" opens a window titled "New Credit Term"; Edit opens the same window titled "Edit Credit Term". The buttons are "Cancel" and "Create Credit Term" (New) or "Save Changes" (Edit).”
  • S3-R13: “Editing a term keeps its own name valid (saving "Net 10" unchanged on the term "Net 10" is not a duplicate).”
  • S3-N2: “If the term is in use, standard, or inactive, Edit is not offered or is blocked (Story 2: Row menu actions), so the window cannot open in Edit mode for it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
